topicName: Explain the use of the `COMMIT` and `ROLLBACK` statements in PL/SQL.
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Explain the use of the `COMMIT` and `ROLLBACK` statements in PL/SQL."},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"COMMIT and ROLLBACK are transaction control statements in PL/SQL. COMMIT saves all changes made during the current transaction to the database. ROLLBACK undoes all changes made during the current transaction, reverting the database to its previous state."}]
